data.title: Qingling Motors to Boost Stake in Isuzu Joint Venture via Major Connected Deal
data.description:
Qingling Motors Co ( (HK:1122) ) has issued an announcement.

Qingling Motors Co has agreed to acquire approximately 30.43% of the equity interests in Isuzu Qingling Automobile Co (IEC) from its controlling shareholder Qingling Group for about RMB659.87 million. This follows a targeted capital reduction completed in March 2026 that adjusted IEC’s shareholding to 50% Isuzu, 30.43% Qingling Group and 19.57% Qingling Motors.

Upon completion of the deal, Qingling Motors will significantly increase its stake in IEC, consolidating greater control over the joint venture with Isuzu and potentially strengthening its influence over strategic and operational decisions. The transaction is classified as both a major and connected transaction under Hong Kong Listing Rules, requiring independent shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting and oversight by an independent board committee and financial adviser to protect minority investor interests.
